job.question: What evaluation criteria and percentage weights does the Texas Municipal Retirement System (TMRS) global custody RFP use to evaluate respondents?
job.expected_facts: 1. Scope Affirmation, Servicing Approach, and Institutional Credentials - 25%; 2. Core and Value Added Services and Technology Platforms - 40%; 3. Quality of Response and Additional Evidence of Capability - 10%; 4. Competitiveness & Reasonableness of Economics - 25%.
job.acceptance: Accept faithful shorter criterion names with correct mapping 25/40/10/25. Supporting subcriteria are optional.

reviews.reason: This is an Apple Valley Fire Protection District RFP for OPEB actuarial services, not the TMRS global custody RFP. Its evaluation criteria do not provide the four requested criteria or their percentage weights.
quotes: The Apple Valley Fire Protection District is accepting proposals from qualified consultants for Actuarial Services
AVFPD will evaluate the responses and make a recommendation to the AVFPD Board for approval.
The evaluation committee will consider the following factors:
1. Understanding of the services required. 2. Quality, clarity, and responsiveness of proposal. 3. Proposed fees.
